findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_data, annotate_genes, pulse_gene_view · Private data: search_data, data_sources, get_paper, blast_sequence · Public sink: pulse_gene_view.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_data, annotate_genes, pulse_gene_view · Private data: search_data, data_sources, get_paper, blast_sequence · Public sink: pulse_gene_view

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
